task_definition.task_description: Please check the current weather in Tokyo and convert 22°C to Fahrenheit for me, then look up the Hilton Tokyo and book a deluxe room there for Alex Johnson from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-12. After that, scan for devices in the living room, check the status of the living room light, prepare and apply a change to set its brightness to 70, then set the living room AC to cool at 22°C and give me the AC change details in a readable format.
